summary: Stocks are pulling back from yesterday's record highs as the 10-year Treasury yield hit a 24-year high. Oil spiked on attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, rattling risk assets including crypto.
market_note: Index futures point to a soft finish; traders are watching the Fed meeting minutes due later today.

items.why: Bitcoin broke below $84,000 as the Hormuz attacks pushed oil above $101 and lifted Treasury yields and the dollar. Failed rallies near $87,000 triggered about $547M in long liquidations.
Meta was the only Magnificent Seven stock to fall on Tuesday's AI rally and it is sliding again today, caught in the broader pullback as rising yields pressure growth stocks.
AMD is cooling off after Tuesday's near 3% pop to a record on Citi and Mizuho price target hikes. Profit-taking is hitting chip stocks as Treasury yields climb.
Amazon is extending yesterday's run, when it led the Magnificent Seven up nearly 2%, riding AI optimism and bullish analyst chatter around AWS growth.
